G35 readings stated while ruling A03 instantiate [0,100) (they read G35 and change no ruling rule): (1) G35's own example of the order, monsterhunter's 'It's done!' (h+35.63) then 'time for upkeep now' (h+35.64), is two posts by two members; a single post whose words report the work made, finished, complete or placed and then turn to keeping it shows the order too, since the upkeep names a build the same words report ('We have built the American flag. Now we must maintain it.', AmericanFlaginPlace; 'Done... Maintain', Russiaclan); (2) G15 stays strict for the report end: a bare 'We did it!', 'Great job', 'Yeah we did!' or 'now we have to maintain it' reports no state of the work, so a line holding only that and upkeep shows one end (armenia, MMA, Slovakia, TeamDignitas, anaheimducks 'We've done it!'); 'we made it' counts as made, as G15 read bahrain ('We made it boys', PUBATTLEGROUNDS), and a cheer with an image counts as the image (bitcoin, AceOfAngels8); (3) a first report that is itself damage ('OK our flag is being destroyed Gotta fix that.', australia) is P03 and P05 at once, the class G35 counts apart (J), unless an earlier report of building is shown; (4) a line whose upkeep comes before its only report is counted with the bound (Peru, bisexual, bakchodi), and a line that drops upkeep as too costly shows no act of upkeep (TheFarLeftSide).
